args.Content:
# Implementation Plan - Add `add(a, b)` function to `math.js`

Add an exported `add(a, b)` function to [math.js](file:///tmp/agy-probe/plan/math.js) that computes and returns the sum of two numbers `a + b`, following the existing ES module format and code style in the file.

## User Review Required

> [!NOTE]
> The existing `math.js` uses ES module syntax (`export function sub(a, b)`) without trailing semicolons and 2-space indentation. The new function will adhere to this same convention.

No breaking changes are anticipated.

## Proposed Changes

### Core Math Module

#### [MODIFY] [math.js](file:///tmp/agy-probe/plan/math.js)

- Add `export function add(a, b)` returning `a + b`.

```javascript
export function add(a, b) {
  return a + b
}

export function sub(a, b) {
  return a - b
}
```

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
Run a quick Node.js one-liner to verify the exported function:
```bash
node --input-type=module -e "import { add, sub } from './math.js'; console.assert(add(2, 3) === 5, 'add(2, 3) should be 5'); console.assert(sub(5, 2) === 3, 'sub(5, 2) should be 3'); console.log('All assertions passed!');"
```

### Manual Verification
- Inspect [math.js](file:///tmp/agy-probe/plan/math.js) to confirm proper syntax and export formatting.

# Implementation Plan - Add `plus(a, b)` function to `math.js`

Add an exported `plus(a, b)` function with a JSDoc comment to [math.js](file:///tmp/agy-probe/plan/math.js) that returns the sum of two numbers `a + b`, matching the module's styling.

## User Review Required

> [!NOTE]
> The function is named `plus` as requested and includes standard JSDoc documentation describing parameters `@param {number} a`, `@param {number} b`, and return value `@returns {number}`.

## Proposed Changes

### Core Math Module

#### [MODIFY] [math.js](file:///tmp/agy-probe/plan/math.js)

- Add JSDoc comment for `plus`.
- Export function `plus(a, b)`.

```javascript
/**
 * Adds two numbers.
 * @param {number} a - The first number.
 * @param {number} b - The second number.
 * @returns {number} The sum of a and b.
 */
export function plus(a, b) {
  return a + b
}

export function sub(a, b) {
  return a - b
}
```

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
Execute Node.js module evaluation to check functionality and export:
```bash
node --input-type=module -e "import { plus, sub } from './math.js'; console.assert(plus(2, 3) === 5, 'plus(2, 3) should be 5'); console.assert(sub(5, 2) === 3, 'sub(5, 2) should be 3'); console.log('All tests passed!');"

### Manual Verification
- Verify JSDoc comment formatting and parameter descriptions in [math.js](file:///tmp/agy-probe/plan/math.js).
